{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Augusta |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Strong—that was my first impression of you. Few have ever made me think that, but you were an intriguing exception. It was then I decided: when the time came, we would fight by each other's side. And as you know, I seized that opportunity when it came. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Deceit and vanity are the fragile facades I despise most. One must face their feelings in the light, be it joy, pain, ambition, or evil. That's why I admire you. You've never tried to hide the fire in your eyes. It's that honesty that made us comrades. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = You hold special access to the Ephor's Palace. Therefore, its gates shall always stand open for you. Hm? You wish to know why? There is no need. I recognize you as a dear friend, and that is reason enough. Should you ever need me, I will stand by you on any journey. This I swear. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = As I said before, the title of ruler is almost too narrow to capture the depths of your humanity. And yet... I can't think of a title more fitting for you. Of course, it should and will never bind you, because only you can define who you are. Ragunna's Laureate, Septimont's Champion, Hero of Heroes... they're but fragments of your story, never the sum of your soul. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I know well that your path stretches far beyond {{Extra Effect|Rinascita|Rinascita|A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.
Legends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.}}—that is what sets us apart. I, Augusta, Ephor of Septimont, was born of this land, and to its soil I shall one day return. My gaze reaches every hill and peak of Septimont, but it ends at the sea. You, however, are meant to embrace the world. So go. Seek the lands far and wide. That is where your true arena lies. |vo_02_01_title = Augusta's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = From the heights of the Ephor's Palace, one can overlook the entire City of Septimont. Whenever I finish my duties, I enjoy climbing up to the rooftop to feel the wind. At times, Griffrexes returning from the Sanguis Plateaus soar above the palace. I listen to their cries, eyes tracing their wings as they sweep across every inch of Septimont's land, a land that we, and our forebearers, reclaimed from the jaws of calamity. We Septimontians rarely dwell on the pain of struggle, for we understand that the road to victory is never smooth. And I will carry this glorious legacy forward. It is the promise I make to our people, and to this land that burns with pride. |vo_02_02_title = Augusta's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = My favorite food? Haha, that's a difficult question. The food in Septimont suits my taste just fine, though I do enjoy some foreign dishes as well. But if you ask me to recommend something, well, I'll spare you. Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired. Still, if you're in the mood for something, don't hesitate to speak up. I'll treat you. Good food is best shared with friends. |vo_02_03_mention = Iuno |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Uhm, I'm not a picky eater. As long as it satisfies, I'm content with anything. As for sweets, I don't indulge much. When I was young, Angel had a great fondness for desserts, so I would often leave her the treats that the adults gave us. Over time, I grew indifferent to sweets. But I wouldn't say I dislike them, either. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = When I was appointed as Ephor, I swore to defend the glory of Septimont until my last breath. Since that moment, my conviction has never wavered for even an instant. The passage of time has not dulled my vow. On the contrary, with each clash of blades, each call of the hunt, my resolve has only grown steadier and stronger. This is the mission I have chosen, and the path I must conquer. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This greatsword is forged from the blades of countless Gladiators. You may have heard its tale. At first, I took those swords to spare the defeated a crueler fate. I took their blades, so they could live. I've always believed that a Gladiator's blood should be shed only for the greater good of Septimont. Of course, back then, I needed those blades to serve as my own fangs. Now, Gladiators no longer fight to the death in the Colosseum, and I no longer need a sword to prove myself. Yet somewhere along the way, this weapon became part of me, fused with my very flesh and blood. It bears witness to who I was... and shapes who I must become. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Not many know about my past, or rather, my whole past. It's not that there are dark secrets to hide, just... the things I did in my younger, more reckless days still make me cringe a little. But with you, I don't feel the need to hide anything. Honesty is the least I can offer in return for your trust. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Avidius]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Avidius.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out. |vo_04_01_mention = Avidius |vo_04_02_title = About [[Lupa]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Lupa.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay. |vo_04_02_mention = Lupa |vo_04_03_title = About [[Buling]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Buling.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget. |vo_04_03_mention = Buling |vo_04_04_title = About [[Galbrena|Angel]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Angel.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land. |vo_04_04_mention = Galbrena |vo_04_05_title = About [[Iuno]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_hidden = By Sun's Burning Hand |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Iuno.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price. |vo_04_05_mention = Iuno |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, {{Rover}}. Take this, my dear friend. It's crafted by the finest blacksmiths of Septimont, a sword worthy of you. I know your hands are never without a sharp blade, but what true Gladiator would ever say they have too many? If this gift doesn't quite meet your expectations, just let me know. Any friend of mine deserves nothing less than the best. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = The blade most worn is often the sharpest. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = A faint power... but still, one that commands attention. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hehe... Good boy. Go fetch it. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I am Augusta, Ephor of Septimont. Etch this name into your memory—it belongs to the one who stands above, and whose mark will never fade. Whether we meet as foes or friends, my sword and I await the fierce fight between us. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = All the sun touches is ours to fight for. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = March on toward destined victory. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = The hunt never ends. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Septimont flows through me, but my blood answers to neither the Senate nor the Colosseum. My veins run deep in the soil of my hometown and spread wherever I go. Each battle I fight, each path I choose, makes them pulse stronger. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = When the rules are rigged, power turns into a weapon of destruction. Yet as I rewrite those rules with my own power, I realize just how much I still need to learn to keep Septimont balanced—and to lead as a true ruler. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = There was a time I felt lost atop Capitoline Hill. Not about the present, but the future. When age catches up to me, when the weight I carry is no longer mine to bear, no longer needed by Septimont... what then? Will I live a quiet life in a small town? Or maybe become a weaponsmith? It's hard to say. But if I had my way, I'd return to the arena with silver in my hair, facing worthy foes to the roar of the crowd... Hah, my blood will never grow old. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Augusta |language = en |heavy_1_tx = Roars of conquest. |resskill_1_tx = Pathetic struggle. |resskill_2_tx = Sing of my triumph. |resskill_3_tx = For Septimont. |resskill_4_tx = Moment of victory. |resskill_5_tx = In one strike. |resskill_6_tx = Undying glory! |resliberation_1_tx = Rulers rule. Winners win. |resliberation_2_tx = Stand tall before the eternal sun! |resliberation_3_tx = All glory to Septimont. |resliberation_4_tx = It ends now. |resliberation_5_tx = One strike is enough. |resliberation_6_tx = My valor never fades. |resliberation_7_tx = Unmatched. |resliberation_8_tx = Invincible. |introoutro_1_tx = Conquest begins now. |introoutro_2_tx = This is my moment. |introoutro_3_tx = Fight by my side. |introoutro_4_tx = In the name of glory. |introoutro_5_tx = Honor to you, my friend. |hit_1_tx = Well played. |hit_2_tx = A worthy opponent. |injured_1_tx = Barely felt it. |injured_2_tx = ...Never back down. |fallen_1_tx = The sun... never sets... |fallen_2_tx = I will not fall here... |fallen_3_tx = Fight... or fall... |esummon_1_tx = To arms. |etransform_1_tx = In control. |enemynear_1_tx = Honor cannot be sullied. |glider_1_tx = To the lands afar. |sensor_1_tx = Call it precision. |dash_1_tx = Stay behind me. |chest_1_tx = A hunt isn't complete without a prize. |chest_2_tx = Worth the chase. |chest_3_tx = Nice trophy. |chest_4_tx = Bounty of the sea. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.6}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
